titulo: Label the box before you shelve it for next year
caption:
Label the box before you shelve it for next year

The string of lights comes down, goes into one box, and gets a label for next year.

For whoever labels the box for next year.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with a voice on a flat color background at a table. At the top, the words: 1 box. 1 label. For whoever writes it for next year. A small doorway-shaped figure with white eyes stands to the left. A string of six amber bulbs hangs across the top and an open cardboard box sits on the table at the right. The words appear one line at a time: the lights come down. Into the box (the bulbs drop one by one into the box). I label the lid (a white label that says lights, dec. slides onto the front of the box). See you next year (the flaps close and her eyes close in a smile). The closing line: for whoever labels the box for next year. Then: Choose friction.
comentario_fijado: Cella labeled the box today. Somebody will thank her next year.
evolucion: Dos apuestas (junta-ene-s1, seccion 3). (a) El cierre con persona, sin pedido: ninguna pieza pide guardar, comentar, compartir, enviar ni seguir (regla 8); el fijado es una frase de Cella que nombra al destinatario. Base de lectura: N2 16 % (14 de 88 Reels), 1,5 envios por 1.000 de alcance, mediana de alcance 117; con el mismo corte de la hora 168. (b) El destinatario como gancho: brazo A (abre con "For whoever ..." en el cuadro 0 y vuelve a cerrar) contra brazo B (solo cierra). Se mide a 48 h con medir.py (envios por 1.000 de alcance, vistas comprometidas) y a 7 dias con objetivos.py (N2, N4). Con 17 seguidores no separa causa de ruido: lectura de orden de magnitud. Semana sin largos ni medios (prueba 3a del acta).
